confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for London prices. The price search returned Numbeo-based figures, mainly via Expatica (June 2026) and Londonwebcam, which I did not open. I converted GBP to USD at roughly 1.33, an assumed rate that I did not look up. The cocktail figure is the weakest, because the only source was a 2020 figure of about £11, so I scaled it up to about £13 and tied it to the beer price. Wine by the glass is an estimate of about £8.50, based on a quoted £7-12 range. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against any listings. London summer prices vary widely by neighbourhood.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on London's own aggregated price-index data, with accommodation set by general knowledge of London's expensive, high-demand hostel and hotel market.
